references.text: Moses introduces the laws and statutes that Israel is to follow, which are directly linked to the teaching mentioned in verse 5.
The Lord commanded Moses to teach the people statutes and laws they were to keep in the land they were about to take possession of.
Moses received a command from the Lord to teach the people the commands, statutes, and laws they were to keep in the land.
Refers to the commands, statutes, and laws that Moses was commanded to teach the people, so that they would keep them in the land.
Introduction to the laws and statutes that the Lord gave through Moses, parallel to the teaching in Deuteronomy.
Summary of the statutes, laws, and rules that the Lord gave between himself and the Israelites through Moses.
Introduction to the specific statutes and laws Israel is to keep in the promised land.
Ezra set his heart to study the law of the Lord and to teach Israel its statutes and laws, in line with Moses' commission.
Jesus commands the disciples to teach all nations to obey everything he has commanded them, parallel to Moses' teaching of God's commands.
